mapper.select: select id, status, tx_hash from faucet_claim_request where idempotency_key = #{key} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into faucet_claim_request (id, chain_id, user_address, token_address, amount_raw, day, claim_nonce, idempotency_key, device_id, ip_hash, status, tx_hash, check_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{requestId}, #{chainId}, #{user}, #{token}, #{amount, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.NumericBigIntegerTypeHandler}, #{day}, #{claimNonce, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.NumericBigIntegerTypeHandler}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{deviceId}, #{ipHash}, 'SUBMITTED', #{txHash}, #{checkAt, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, now(), now())

insert into faucet_user_daily (chain_id, user_address, day, claim_count, last_claim_at) values (#{chainId}, #{user}, #{day}, 1, now()) on conflict (chain_id, user_address, day) do update set claim_count = faucet_user_daily.claim_count + 1, last_claim_at = excluded.last_claim_at

insert into faucet_ip_daily (chain_id, ip_hash, day, claim_count) values (#{chainId}, #{ipHash}, #{day}, 1) on conflict (chain_id, ip_hash, day) do update set claim_count = faucet_ip_daily.claim_count + 1

insert into faucet_token_daily_issued (chain_id, token_address, day, issued_raw) values (#{chainId}, #{token}, #{day}, #{amount, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.NumericBigIntegerTypeHandler}) on conflict (chain_id, token_address, day) do update set issued_raw = faucet_token_daily_issued.issued_raw + excluded.issued_raw
mapper.update: update faucet_token_config set vault_balance_raw = vault_balance_raw - #{amount, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.NumericBigIntegerTypeHandler}, updated_at = now() where chain_id = #{chainId} and token_address = #{token}
mapper.select: select id, chain_id, tx_hash, check_at, created_at from faucet_claim_request where status = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.update: update faucet_claim_request set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.select: select chain_id, user_address, token_address, amount_raw, day, ip_hash from faucet_claim_request where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update faucet_claim_request set check_at = #{checkAt, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} and status = 'SUBMITTED'
